Zero HOT setups. Zero WARM setups. You gotta be kidding me. What kind of market are we in right now where absolutely nothing is lighting up? That’s the question you *should* be asking yourself. The market is telling us something. Are we listening? When the entire squeeze universe is a ghost town, that’s not an accident. It’s a message. Risk is off. Full stop.

Let’s zoom out. The indexes are stuck in no man’s land, chopping back and forth with nothing resembling a meaningful trend. It’s the kind of environment that flushes out the tourists who only showed up when tech was ripping or energy was squeezing the shorts. But here’s your cheat code: while the macro noise is deafening, leadership is quietly shifting again. Energy is hanging tough, holding its ground after that monster Q4 rally, and uranium ($UUUU, $NNE) continues to heat up under the radar. Meanwhile, no one is talking about biotech ($MRNA, $IOVA, $BBIO, $PGEN)—and that’s exactly why it deserves your attention. 

Back to the portfolio. Plenty of these names have already doubled or more, but some setups are still actionable if you missed the first leg. **$AFRM, $NIO, and $GRPN are sitting on solid YTD gains but haven’t hit that euphoric, overextended phase yet.** New money could definitely sneak in here. Elsewhere, $IOVA is up 72% since our entry and feels like it’s coiling for something bigger, especially with biotech starting to perk up. If you don’t have exposure there, that’s one to watch closely. On the “stretch your winners” side of the book, $UUUU and $MRNA are the poster children. Both have doubled; both have more in the tank. Wouldn’t be surprised if $MRNA starts targeting $8 from here.

No double-down alerts today, no HOT squeezes—feels weird, right? That’s the reality of trading a trend-following strategy in a choppy environment, though. Right here, right now, it’s about separating the “must-owns” from the noise and maintaining a disciplined watchlist so you’re ready when the next wave comes. Because it *always* comes. 

Today, keep an eye on $UUUU and $NNE. Uranium might be the sneaky macro play no one sees coming, and those are the ones that can go parabolic when they catch momentum. And don’t sleep on $AFRM—fintech has been left for dead, but the tape is firming up. If $AFRM can hold above $3, that could be a green light for a fresh breakout. As for the rest, let’s stay patient. Zero doesn’t mean nothing is happening—it means the pressure is building.
